subject: DI02000161

body.en:
Understand the idea

Positive logic assigns HIGH to1;negative logic assigns LOW to1.The voltage levels are unchanged;the interpretation changes.

Explanation and application

  • AND requires every input1;OR requires at least one1;NOT complements one input.NAND/NOR complement AND/OR.
  • Two-input XOR is1for unequal inputs;XNOR is1for equal inputs.For more than two inputs,XOR means odd parity,not simply all inputs different.
  • Bubble denotes inversion/active-low meaning;IEC rectangles use function labels.A gate symbol is not a pin diagram and does not specify supply voltage.
What makes NANDuniversal?

NOT,ANDandORcan all be formed solely from NAND;these suffice to realise Boolean expressions.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Positive logicમાં HIGH=1;negative logicમાં LOW=1છે.Voltage levels બદલાતા નથી,interpretation બદલાય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • AND માટે બધા inputs1;OR માટે ઓછામાં ઓછો એક1જોઈએ;NOT એક input invert કરે.NAND/NOR અનુક્રમે AND/ORના complements છે.
  • Two-input XOR unequal inputs માટે1અને XNOR equal inputs માટે1છે.બેથી વધુ inputsમાં XOR odd parity દર્શાવે છે,બધા inputs જુદા હોવા નહિ.
  • Bubble inversion/active-low દર્શાવે છે;IEC rectanglesમાં function labels હોય છે.Gate symbol pin diagram નથી અને supply voltage નક્કી કરતું નથી.
NAND Universal કેમ?

ફક્તNANDથીNOT,AND,ORબને;તેનાથીBooleanexpressionsrealiseથાય.

Understand the idea

Normally-open contacts close when their variable is1;normally-closed contacts open when it is1.A completed path denotes logical1.

Explanation and application

  • Series contacts realise AND;parallel paths realise OR.A complemented literal uses the corresponding normally-closed contact.
  • For XOR,the two paths are A·B′and A′·B;for XNORthey are ABand A′B′.This is a functional equivalent,not a literal ICtransistor schematic or mains wiring instruction.

Understand the idea

Universal means NOT,AND and OR can all be constructed from that one gate type;therefore any Boolean network can be realised.

Explanation and application

  • First realise inversion with tied inputs,then use De Morgan to change the AND/OR polarity.Count shared intermediate gates only once in a physical design.
  • A two-input NOT construction uses1gate;one basic function uses2gates and the other3gates.Verify the actual network rather than memorising only the count.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Universalનો અર્થ એ જ gate typeથી NOT,AND,OR બનાવી શકાય;તેથી કોઈપણ Boolean network realise થઈ શકે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Tied inputsથી inversion બનાવો,પછી De Morganથી AND/OR polarity ફેરવો.Physical designમાં shared intermediate gate એક જ વાર ગણો.
  • Two-input NOT constructionમાં1gate;એક basic functionમાં2અને બીજામાં3gates লাগে.ફક્ત count યાદ કરવાને બદલે actual network verify કરો.
